newsitem.title: IRAQ: Uday is leader of Iraqi journalists again.
newsitem.headline: Uday is leader of Iraqi journalists again.

text.p: President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday has accepted a request by Iraqi journalists to head their union again, state-run newspapers reported on Saturday.

The papers published a picture of Uday in a wheelchair receiving Union representatives who communicated to him a decision more than 1,200 Iraqi journalists took on Friday to have him as chairman once again.
Uday, who was shot and wounded in Baghdad in December, was the head of Iraqi Journalists Union for two terms but gave up the post last year.
"We pray the Almighty to be with us all to serve the journalistic family which has been prospering with glory under...leader Saddam Hussein," the papers quoted Uday as saying.
Uday is also chairman of the Iraqi Olympic Committee and owns Iraq's most influential newspaper Babel as well as the popular Shebab television channel.
Latest television footage showed Uday in a wheelchair with his left leg still in bandages, moving both hands at ease.
